description.zh: 把值得反复听的声音，变成可以慢慢读的文字；持续整理科技、创业与 AI 播客。
description.en: Transforms long videos, podcasts, web media, and audio files into polished Chinese transcripts with HTML, PDF, EPUB, backlog tracking, and site publishing support.

quickPrompts.zh: 请把这个视频或播客整理成可阅读的中文逐字稿，并生成配套交付文件。
quickPrompts.en: Please turn this video or podcast into a readable Chinese transcript with supporting deliverables.

quickPrompts.zh: 请检查这个网页里的音视频来源，优先获取字幕，无法获取时再转录。
quickPrompts.en: Please inspect the media source on this webpage, fetch subtitles first, and transcribe only if needed.

quickPrompts.zh: 请把这期播客归档入账，并同步维护后续待处理节目 backlog。
quickPrompts.en: Please archive this podcast episode and update the backlog for future candidate episodes.

description.zh: 将用户出生信息转换为可复用的紫微斗数人生报告生成流程，报告表达避免术语堆砌、宿命化、鸡汤化和具体事件臆测。
description.en: Creates a practical Zi Wei life report from normalized birth data, solar-time correction, chart generation, and clear narrative analysis.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据我的出生信息生成一份紫微斗数人生报告
quickPrompts.en: Create a Zi Wei life report from my birth details.

quickPrompts.zh: 先帮我校正真太阳时并生成星盘
quickPrompts.en: Correct my solar time and generate the birth chart first.

quickPrompts.zh: 生成适合分享的 HTML 报告和长图
quickPrompts.en: Generate a shareable HTML report and long image.
